subject: Encryption evidence and rotation runbook — LynxBank SIG ask
messages:
From: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@lynxbank.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: LynxBank SIG: encryption artifacts and rotation runbook request

Hi Ben / Marissa,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. As part of our SIG intake were consolidating the encryption & key management artifacts. Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide the following items for LynxBank's tenant?

- Signed rotation manifest (JWS) covering the last 12 months (examples of key IDs and rotation timestamps).
- HSM vendor attestation / tamper-evidence certificate for any hardware that stores root wrapping keys.
- KMS audit log export (operator actions, key usage, key schedule changes) for 2027-06-01 to 2028-05-31.
- Emergency rotation runbook (procedural steps and contact matrix).
- A brief description of BYOK / customer-wrapped-key handling and whether we store any unwrapped material.

We attached the SIG questionnaire page covering encryption for reference. If there's a preferred secure delivery channel for the artifacts (SFTP, presigned S3, encrypted Drive link), let us know. Ideally we'd have the artifacts for initial review by EOD Mon, 25 Jun.

Also: if you can provide a small signed manifest (a one-off JWS sample) so we can verify verification steps on our side, that would speed review.

Appreciate it — let me know if you want a quick call to align.

Alex
Alex Mercer
Senior InfoSec Engineer, LynxBank
security@lynxbank.com

Attachments: lynxbank-SIG-questions.pdf (PDF)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@lynxbank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Jun 2028 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: LynxBank SIG: encryption artifacts and rotation runbook request

Hi Alex —

Thanks for the clear list. We can deliver the items you listed. High-level plan:

1) Well produce a compact, signed rotation manifest (JWS) with sample verification steps.
2) HSM attestation will be the vendor-signed tamper-evidence cert and a short operator statement.
3) KMS audit logs: we can export operator actions and key usage as CSV/Parquet, with redaction where necessary — Marissa will include exact formats and redaction rules.
4) Emergency rotation runbook and contact matrix — we will provide a runbook + SLA table.
5) BYOK summary: short write-up on wrapping/unwrapping lifecycle and guarantees that no unwrapped customer key material is persistently stored.

Delivery preferences: we can upload artifacts to a short-lived, encrypted Drive folder (link) or transfer via SFTP. Which do you prefer? Were also happy to ship an initial sample JWS to the email address you used (or to a verification key URL you provide).

Proposed timeline: initial sample JWS and redaction instructions by Fri, 23 Jun; full packet by Mon, 25 Jun. If you need it sooner, we can prioritize.

Shall we lock a 30-min call on Mon 25 Jun at 09:00 PT to walk through?

Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

Attachments: none

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@lynxbank.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 23 Jun 2028 08:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: LynxBank SIG: encryption artifacts and rotation runbook request

Alex —

Following up with technical specifics so you can validate against your SIG checklist. See inline below and attached samples (rotation-manifest-sample.json, redaction-instructions.txt).

---
Rotation manifest (what we'll provide):
- Format: compact JWS (RFC 7515) with a JSON payload summarizing key rotations.
- Fields included: key_id, previous_key_id (if wrapped), rotation_timestamp (ISO8601), operator_id, rotation_type (scheduled|emergency|auto), reason (short string).
- Signing: signed with Redwoods KMS operator signing key (X.509 chain available in attestation package).
- Delivery: one signed file per quarter for the 12-month window; plus a single concatenated manifest for the whole period.

HSM attestation:
- We'll deliver the vendor attestation cert (vendor-signed) plus an operator-signed seal file that references HSM serial numbers and firmware versions.
- Attestation will include a statement of tamper evidence and the last HSM health-check timestamp.

KMS audit logs:
- Scope: operator actions (create/rotate/deprecate), key usage events (encrypt/decrypt/wrap/unwrap), KMS admin changes.
- Time range: 2027-06-01 to 2028-05-31 as requested.
- Format options: CSV (row per event) or Parquet (columnar). We will provide both compressed.
- Redaction: we will remove UUIDs that map to internal ephemeral sessions per your redaction rules; see redaction-instructions.txt for the exact fields we will redact.

BYOK handling:
- For customer BYOKs we accept a wrapped key blob. Redwood never persistently stores unwrapped customer keys; unwrapping happens transiently in a sealed runtime guarded by HSM controls, and the unwrapped key is zeroed from memory post-operation.

Emergency rotation runbook:
- Includes step-by-step commands (operator and SRE playbooks), contact matrix (operator primary/secondary), and a test checklist.

Delivery method & verification sample:
- For delivery of full artifacts we recommend: (1) SFTP to a LynxBank-managed host (you provide creds) or (2) a pre-signed, time-limited S3 URL restricted to LynxBank IP ranges. If you prefer Google Drive, we will encrypt the bundle with a PGP key you provide.
- Sample JWS: attached rotation-manifest-sample.json is a minimal, non-production signed manifest. It includes a documentation block showing the verification curl command and the public verification key URL.

Timeline: We will send the sample JWS + redaction instructions by EOD Fri 23 Jun (today). Full export and attestation package by Mon 25 Jun. If you need additional cryptographic proof (e.g., a signed timestamp from the HSM vendor), we can request that from the vendor but it may add 2-3 business days.

Let me know delivery preference and whether we should wrap artifacts in an NDA/transfer agreement.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Security & Compliance Lead, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Attachments: rotation-manifest-sample.json (sample JWS payload), redaction-instructions.txt (plain text)

Ben / Marissa —

Thanks for the clear plan and the sample artifacts — I confirm we received the sample JWS and redaction instructions and they look good. A couple of follow-ups before we ingest the full packet: 

1) Delivery: SFTP is preferred. I'll circulate host/creds via our secure ticket and send a one-time password. Please avoid sending the full bundle over email.
2) Proof sample: for verification wed like one small production-signed manifest (not containing real key material) that demonstrates the actual signing chain we will verify. Can Marissa produce a production-signed manifest with the operator signature and include the public verification key URL?
3) NDA/transfer: we have a short log transfer agreement that our legal team prefers for audit log exports. Ill attach the document; would you review and indicate if Redwood needs any changes?

We can take the full packet after we confirm delivery method and sign the transfer agreement. Im happy to keep the Mon 25 Jun 09:00 PT slot if you want to run through the verification together — would be useful to walk the verification steps end-to-end.

Alex
Alex Mercer
Senior InfoSec Engineer, LynxBank
security@lynxbank.com
